commands.name: split-right
commands.description: Split the focused pane: its shown tab moves to a new pane on the right.

commands.name: split-down
commands.description: Split the focused pane: its shown tab moves to a new pane below.

commands.name: focus-left
commands.description: Focus the pane to the left of the focused one.

commands.name: focus-right
commands.description: Focus the pane to the right of the focused one.

commands.name: focus-up
commands.description: Focus the pane above the focused one.

commands.name: focus-down
commands.description: Focus the pane below the focused one.

commands.name: maximize
commands.description: Show the focused pane alone, or bring the others back.

commands.name: close-pane
commands.description: Close the focused pane; its tabs join the next one.

commands.name: unsplit
commands.description: Put every tab back in one pane.
